description: Google Forms editing. Actions: create_form(title, document_title?), add_question(form_id, title, type, options?, required?, index?, description?), update_question(form_id, item_id, title?, description?, required?, options?), update_settings(form_id, title?, description?, is_quiz?). Destructive (confirm:true): delete_question(form_id, item_id). type is short_text, paragraph, multiple_choice, checkboxes, dropdown, scale, date or time; options is a list of choices.

params.description: Action parameters; destructive actions also need confirm: true

name: forms_admin
